# Salman Sharif

> Senior Software Engineer — Building robust software solutions that drive business growth

Hi, I'm Salman — a Senior Software Engineer at Flywheel Digital, where I've grown from Junior to Senior building the backend behind an ML-powered ad budget optimization product. Day to day I design REST and GraphQL APIs in Python and TypeScript, architect services on GCP with PostgreSQL and BigQuery, and build the data pipelines that move everything from real-time to batch. A lot of my work lately centers on AI — integrating LLM APIs into user-facing features and applying ML to turn campaign data into smarter decisions. Outside of shipping product, I'm happiest automating things: CI/CD at work, and a self-hosted homelab at home where I tinker with networking, storage, and the occasional 3D-printed enclosure. I care just as much about the people I build with — I enjoy mentoring and onboarding teammates and helping teams stay collaborative and inclusive as they grow. I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Software Engineering from the University of Toronto, and I'm always chasing the next interesting problem to solve.

## Experience

- **Senior Software Engineer**, Flywheel Digital (formerly Perpetua Labs) (May 2022 – Present), Toronto, Ontario, Canada
  - Promoted twice from Junior to Senior Software Engineer
  - Led the technical design and end-to-end backend ownership of an ML-powered budget optimization product that trains on up to 2 years of dynamic campaign data to forecast optimal ad-spend allocation, serving roughly 100 users across several hundred campaigns
  - Designed and built REST and GraphQL APIs in Python (Django) and TypeScript, delivering features end-to-end from backend services through React frontends and authoring API specs to align teams on system contracts
  - Architected backend services on GCP using PostgreSQL and BigQuery, and built data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows with Airflow to support real-time and batch ad-spend analytics
  - Built internal Django services with React and TypeScript admin tooling used by other teams to manage campaign data and operations, reducing manual work and reliance on external tools
  - Integrated LLM APIs to build user-facing AI features, wrote unit and integration tests with Pytest, and participated in on-call rotations triaging issues across pipelines, API services, and database performance
- **Automation Engineer Consultant**, TCS & RBC (January 2021 – April 2022), Toronto, Ontario, Canada
  - Automated Mobile Banking manual test cases for release validation using Appium Scripts written in Java, decreasing time to production from 2 weeks to 2 days
  - Developed test cases for new features introduced by developer and design teams using ALM and Design Documentation, improving release and subsequent regression cycles
  - Onboarded new team members for the Automation team by creating documentation for setup/walkthroughs of automation tools, decreasing onboarding time by 4X
- **Software Engineer in Test**, Flipp (May 2019 – August 2019), Toronto, Ontario, Canada
  - Created scripts for automating development tasks using Python, Testrail API, Jenkins, and CircleCI to reduce time to market of new features by 50%
  - Transitioned app from processing data on the app to the server by testing updated codebase, improving app performance by at least 2X
  - Identified 100+ issues within the iOS and Android Flipp app using documentation and requirement lists, achieving nomination of "Bug Master" within the organization
- **QA Engineer**, Ministry of Education (September 2017 – April 2018), Toronto, Ontario, Canada
  - Created automated tools and test cases to simplify manual testing by 3X using HP Unified Functional Testing and Selenium
  - Performance tested multiple applications during upgrade from Oracle 11g to 12c DB, resulting in 3X performance improvement (30s to under 10s response time)
